description:
Retrospective application for side boundary fence of 2.27m tall, rear boundary fence of 2.48m tall and building of a lean to shed against house near fence

Rear fence - The previous fence at the rear had several rotten timber posts so we have replaced this fence with a concrete posts, with concrete base boards, wooden fence panel and trellis. It will have 2no planters for climbing plants to grow into the trellis. The plants in the trellis will also help block light from neighbors garden lighting.

Side boundary fence - The previous fence was low and there were security issues with people climbing over from the green metal cable box into the garden, which was an easy jump with the fence the previous size. The side fence will have 2 climbing plants to grow into the trellis

Lean to shed - The shed is angled 1400W x 900D X 2300H for storage of garden tools and ladder following installation of a heat pump cylinder in the outhouse.

Proposed
Change existing red front garden with black and white Victorian pattern and install wooden bin cover as per sketch. The reason for this is the tiles and concrete front step are broken and uneven.
